# Architecture verification errors and warnings

Diagnostics reported by Metalama.Extensions.Architecture and Metalama.Extensions.Validation.

| Article | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| <xref:lama0900> | Code that isn't experimental uses a declaration marked as experimental. |
| <xref:lama0901> | A type implements an interface that only its defining project is allowed to implement. |
| <xref:lama0902> | The pattern of a regular-expression naming convention isn't a valid regular expression. |
| <xref:lama0903> | The name of a derived type doesn't match the naming convention set on its base class or interface. |
| <xref:lama0904> | A usage validation attribute doesn't define the scope to which the rule applies. |
| <xref:lama0905> | A declaration is used from a context that an architecture rule doesn't allow. |
| <xref:lama0906> | The name of a declaration doesn't match the naming convention set by a fabric. |
| <xref:lama0907> | The type assigned to the ExclusionPredicateType property isn't a valid reference predicate. |
